personality_one_liner: A crisp, hyper-efficient, and trustworthy quick-commerce experience utilizing clean whites and emerald greens to make educational supply shopping instantaneous.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability, but compact lists for product grids to maximize screen real estate. Always account for Safe Area at root.

do's: Apply to the floating persistent cart tray
Apply to the sticky header over scrolling content
Apply to the bottom sheet headers and drag handles
dont's: Do not apply to product cards or standard list rows
Do not apply to form inputs or body content regions

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Drive immediate discovery and quick adds via predictive search, banners, and an optimized 4x2 category grid.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a 'Fetching nearest store' text.
states.empty: Illustration of a student backpack with 'No products found nearby' and a 'Change Location' primary CTA.
states.error: Readable network error message with a 'Retry Connection' button.

screens.layout: Sticky dynamic header (SLA badge, location accordion) at the top -> Search Bar -> Promotional Banner Carousel -> 4x2 Category Grid -> Horizontal Product Rails. Ensure the Floating Cart Tray sits above the bottom tab bar when items are present.

screens.name: Categories
screens.purpose: Enable fast browsing through a split-screen view with a static sidebar rail and dynamic product grid.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the 2-col product grid.
states.empty: No items found in this category message with 'Browse all supplies' CTA.

screens.layout: 25% width sticky vertical sidebar on the left for category selection, 75% width on the right for a 2-column product grid. Each product card includes a morphing '+ ADD' quantity stepper.

screens.name: Live Order Tracking
screens.purpose: Provide real-time visibility into the hyperlocal delivery process with an animated map and step progress.

states.empty: No active orders state with a button to 'Browse Supplies'.
states.error: Failed to load tracking data, retry button provided.

screens.layout: Top half displays the animated route map. Bottom half displays a 4-stage vertical step progress indicator (Order Placed, Packed, Out for Delivery, Delivered) and delivery partner details.

banner_supplies.alt: School supplies flatlay for promotional banner

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' guidelines: maintain crisp layouts, generous spacing, and strict adherence to the emerald green and white palette. Blue and purple colors are completely banned.
Implement the Dynamic Sticky Header with an SLA Badge (e.g., '10 MINS' in brandPrimary text on brandSecondary bg). Tie a bottom sheet accordion to the location section.
The Predictive Search Bar must feature a rotating placeholder ticker (e.g., 'Search NCERT Class 10', 'Search Gel Pens') and a trailing voice icon.

Construct the Split-Screen Category Browse View carefully: 25% width sticky vertical sidebar for categories (selected category gets brandPrimary text/indicator) and 75% width for the 2-column product grid.
For product cards, build a morphing '+ ADD' button. It should start as an 'ADD' pill and morph into a quantity stepper (-, count, +) on tap to satisfy Fitts' Law and quick commerce UX patterns.
Build a Floating Persistent Cart Tray. It must float above the bottom navigation, utilize glassmorphism (expo-blur), and show stacked item avatars, total price, and a checkout CTA.
Checkout Bottom Sheet must include tip chips, delivery instruction chips, a detailed bill breakdown, and a simulated mock payment gateway.

Research Learning: Quick commerce interfaces prioritize speed. Consolidate visual noise, ensure essential details like price and quantity are immediately visible, and utilize white space to separate products from promos.
Implement the Live Order Tracking screen with an animated map and a 4-stage vertical step progress indicator. Use 'success' or 'brandPrimary' colors to indicate completed steps.
Wire up haptics defined in the 'haptics' section for interactions like adding to cart, incrementing quantity, and tab switching.
